blocking.problem: The premise that eliminating poison/undef yields one defined meaning is false. Even flag-free floating-point arithmetic permits nondeterministic NaN sign and payload bits; bitcast can expose these as integer outputs or branch conditions. These executions need not contain UB. See [LLVM's NaN semantics](https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#behavior-of-floating-point-nan-values). Locally, Clang 18.1.3 compiled the same O3-optimised fadd/bitcast/xor function with opposite SSE addition operand orders at -O0 and -O3. Consequently, the listed normalisation does not establish the single F_B shared by native execution and independent executors. Deferring floating point while promising exact native equivalence leaves a correctness-oracle mismatch.
blocking.fix: State that materialised normalisation resolves every remaining observable execution choice, including defined floating-point choices. Prefer a specified deterministic numerical contract, implemented in both the native comparison build and device reference through the same materialised semantics—for example deterministic soft-float, or fully specified canonicalisation and rounding rules that subsequent optimisation must preserve. Resolve remaining fast-math permissions too; checking only final floating-point outputs is insufficient because bitcasts and branches can observe intermediate bits. Alternatively, retain a deterministic Bennett numerical refinement but restrict native differential equivalence to executions independent of LLVM-permitted choices, explicitly classifying the remainder as indeterminate and validating them against the checked reference. I would take the first option.

suggestions: Propagate the chosen interface distinction through remaining shorthand: budget-fault guarantees describe lifted oracles, while quantum actions have their separate admission contract. Replace 'It is not an involution' with 'It need not be an involution'; Hadamard and X are counterexamples.

Generalise §5.1's permutation theorem to a declared permutation P, with the XOR oracle as one instance and an in-place bijection as another. This carries the new action interface through verification without changing the proof technique.
Record the materialised reference program's identity and normalisation version in certificates, so an independent checker can identify exactly which F_B was assessed.
Tighten the landscape's negative comparisons around the missing combination of capabilities, rather than implying that predecessors lack every listed capability individually.
path_to_accept: Resolve B_DEFINED_NONDETERMINISM by choosing and stating the numerical refinement and native-comparison policy in §§3.2 and 5.1, then remove that semantic decision from the deferred portion of §9.11. The other observations are non-blocking refinements.
summary: The founding architecture is credible and unusually precise. Round-4 B_FREEZE_DETERMINISM and B1_FREEZE_REFINEMENT_NOT_NATIVE are resolved by replacing freeze with materialised normalisation; B1_QUANTUM_STATE_WRITE_SEMANTICS is resolved by the oracle/action distinction; B_INPLACE_BOUNDED_INVERSE is resolved by the total-bijection and sufficient-inverse-budget restriction. A distinct blocker remains: defined LLVM floating-point nondeterminism survives the stated normalisation and defeats the promised shared deterministic reference result. This requires a semantic decision, not an implementation milestone.
